Claim 1 (Currently amended): An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the alignment device __analyzes temporal sequences of the demonstrated user actions and matches them to corresponding temporal sequences in the documented procedure__.

Claim 2 (Original): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment.

Claim 3 (Original): The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface.

Claim 4 (Original): The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification.

Claim 5 (Original): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment.

Claim 6 (Original): The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface.

Claim 7 (Original): The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification.

Claim 8 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the at least one similarity metric is based on a similarity of an action type involved in both a demonstrated user action and a document action, __wherein the similarity metric further incorporates a confidence score reflecting the degree of correspondence between the action types__.

Claim 9 (Original): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure.

Claim 10 (Original): The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment.

Claim 11 (Original): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure.

Claim 12 (Original): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, __wherein the alignment device analyzes temporal sequences of the demonstrated user actions and matches them to corresponding temporal sequences in the documented procedure__; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device.

Claim 14 (Cancelled).

Claim 15 (Original): The apparatus of claim 13, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment.

Claim 16 (Original): The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, __wherein the computing step analyzes temporal sequences of the demonstrated user actions and matches them to corresponding temporal sequences in the documented procedure__.

Claim 18 (Original): The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment.

Claim 19 (Original): The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface.

Claim 20 (Original): The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment.

Claim 21 (Original): The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface.

Claim 22 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, wherein the at least one similarity metric is based on a similarity of an action type involved in both a demonstrated user action and a document action, __wherein the similarity metric further incorporates a confidence score reflecting the degree of correspondence between the action types__.

Claim 23 (Original): The method of claim 17, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure.

Claim 24 (Original): The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device.

Claim 25 (Original): The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure.

Claim 26 (Original): The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure.

Claim 27 (Original): A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions as recited in claim 17.

Claim 28 (Currently amended): A method for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the method comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, __wherein the computing step analyzes temporal sequences of the demonstrated user actions and matches them to corresponding temporal sequences in the documented procedure__; visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the computed alignment; and automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the computed alignment.

Claim 29 (Cancelled).

Claim 30 (Original): The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device.

Claim 31 (Original): The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure.

Claim 32 (Original): A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface as recited in claim 28.
